title: b4 with the patatt fork
description: b4 imports patatt as a library. Show b4 am verifying a registry-signed patch when the fork is installed in place of patatt (pip install from the fork's git-vouch branch) and keyringsrc = vouch:. Document the install and config.
acceptance_criteria: Scripted check: b4 am on a patch series signed with a registry key reports the attestation as passing; a revoked key reports failing.
